actual_scope: Prove and construct the exact least ambient dimension and input ranks for commuting idempotents with arbitrary prescribed invertible block pivots A,B, prescribed product block H and maximal Schur-commutator rank 2d over any field.
scope_change_reason: This is a scoped algebraic side theorem, not a proof-assistant formalization. Open next question 1 of #4774 and #4785 explicitly requests unequal scalar block pivots; the new six-map argument handles arbitrary invertible pivots, without commuting A,B,H. No predecessor census or selected endpoint is re-audited.
bottleneck_link: Side result: settles a prescribed-boundary dimension obstruction and gives minimum-size algebraic witnesses. It does not supply or price physical producer/consumer headers, restoration, precision, stock, fixed tapes, recursive compilation or outer transfer, and does not change kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after one universal theorem, explicit attaining construction, bounded exact verification, separate binary replay and clean export; stop without submission if fresh PR/Discussion checks reveal an overlapping prior claim or proof. Do not extend into physical admission or nonmaximal-rank classification.

RESULT.json binds the exact generated fixtures. VERIFY.json registers normal and optimized read-only Python 3.12 replays.
